metadata.description: BentoLabs agent packs and security tooling for Claude Code

plugins.name: sentinel
plugins.description: AI-powered penetration testing. White-box security analysis with live exploitation.

plugins.name: product-dev-pack
plugins.description: Complete product-development agent team — 72 specialists across the full lifecycle from discovery to ship. Includes agent-dispatcher + /dispatch slash command. Companion: marketing-pack.

plugins.name: marketing-pack
plugins.description: Marketing & paid-media agent team — 26 specialists across always-on channels + 5-phase campaign lifecycle. Includes marketing-dispatcher + /dispatch-marketing slash command. Companion: product-dev-pack.

plugins.name: sales-pack
plugins.description: Sales agent team — 8 specialists across 5-stage pipeline (Prospect → Qualify → Solution → Close → Expand) + cross-cutting coach/pipeline-analyst. Includes sales-dispatcher + /dispatch-sales slash command. Companions: product-dev-pack + marketing-pack.

plugins.name: legal-finance-pack
plugins.description: Accountant + lawyer team for the full business — 9 specialists covering bookkeeping, AP, FP&A, tax (the bridge), contract review, GDPR/compliance, and SOC 2/ISO/HIPAA audits. 2-tree dispatch (RECURRING-OPS + PROJECT). Includes legal-finance-dispatcher + /dispatch-legal-finance slash command. Companions: product-dev-pack, marketing-pack, sales-pack.
